- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The history of photography began in the early 19th century with Joseph Nicéphore Niépce developing the first photographic image in 1826 using a process called heliography.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] William Henry Fox Talbot invented the calotype process, allowing multiple printings from a single negative image.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Mathew Brady is known for his portraits of famous figures and documentation of the American Civil War.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Alfred Stieglitz, Edward Steichen, and Paul Strand were influential in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, establishing photography as a legitimate art form.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ansel Adams and Robert Frank created iconic images of American landscapes and culture in the mid-20th century.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Contemporary photography is diverse, with countless artists working in various styles and techniques.
